requirements.title: UBOUND argument restrictions
requirements.definition: ARRAY shall be assumed-rank or an array, shall not be an unallocated allocatable or disassociated pointer, assumed-size ARRAY requires DIM present with a value less than rank, DIM shall be an integer scalar in the range one through rank with a present associated allocated corresponding actual, and KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

pending.UBOUND-ARRAY-assumed-rank-or-array: Positive controls call UBOUND on an explicit-shape array A(-3:4,7:9), an assumed-rank dummy with rank-two actual, and a scalar assumed-rank actual for the DIM-absent p5 case; source-control mutation uses a non-array non-assumed-rank actual.
pending.UBOUND-ARRAY-allocated-or-associated: Positive controls allocate an allocatable array with bounds -2:5 and associate a pointer with a target before UBOUND; source-control mutations leave each unallocated or disassociated and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.UBOUND-assumed-size-requires-DIM-less-th: Positive control uses assumed-size dummy D(2:4,5:*) and calls UBOUND(D,DIM=1); source-control mutations omit DIM or use DIM=2 and claim no diagnostic facet.
pending.UBOUND-DIM-integer-scalar-in-rank-range: Positive controls call UBOUND(A,DIM=1) and UBOUND(A,DIM=2) for rank-two A; source-control mutations use DIM=0, DIM=3, and rank-one DIM expressions.
pending.UBOUND-DIM-corresponding-actual-present-: Positive wrapper passes present, associated, and allocated actual DIM values before UBOUND; source-control mutations pass absent optional, disassociated pointer, and unallocated allocatable DIM actuals.
pending.UBOUND-KIND-scalar-integer-constant-expr: Positive control calls UBOUND(A,KIND=selected_int_kind(18)); 7.4.3.1 p2 requires an integer representation method with decimal exponent range at least 18. Assert result kind; source-control mutations use a nonconstant integer variable and a rank-one KIND expression.

requirements.title: UBOUND result characteristics
requirements.definition: The result is integer with KIND-selected or default kind, scalar with DIM present, and otherwise a rank-one array of size equal to rank n of ARRAY.

pending.UBOUND-result-integer-kind-default-or-KI: Call UBOUND on A(-3:4,7:9) without KIND and with KIND=selected_int_kind(18); assert KIND of results equals default integer kind and the selected kind respectively.
pending.UBOUND-result-scalar-with-DIM: Initialize integer sentinel to -999, call UBOUND(A,DIM=2) for A(-3:4,7:9), and assert scalar value 9.
pending.UBOUND-result-rank-one-size-rank-without: Call UBOUND(A) for A(-3:4,7:9); assert SIZE(result)==2 and elements match scalar DIM inquiries. Companion assumed-rank dummy associated with scalar x=17 asserts SIZE(UBOUND(dummy))==0.

requirements.title: UBOUND DIM-present result value
requirements.definition: With DIM present, a whole array with nonzero extent yields the upper bound for that dimension, assumed-rank uses whole-array semantics with assumed-size final extent considered -1, and other cases yield the number of elements in that dimension.

pending.UBOUND-DIM-whole-nonzero-extent-upper-bo: Use whole rank-two A(-3:4,7:9); assert UBOUND(A,DIM=1)==4 and UBOUND(A,DIM=2)==9, mutating expected upper bounds to extents [8,3].
pending.UBOUND-DIM-assumed-rank-whole-array-sema: Pass A(-3:4,7:9) to an assumed-rank dummy and assert UBOUND(dummy,DIM=1)==4 and DIM=2 gives 9; separate chain passes assumed-size D(2:4,5:*) through assumed-rank and asserts final DIM result -1.
pending.UBOUND-DIM-otherwise-dimension-extent: Use section A(-3:4:2,7:9) and assert UBOUND(section,DIM=1)==4 and DIM=2==3 because extents are returned. Use whole zero-extent A(5:4,7:9); derive DIM=1 from the otherwise rule as the number of elements in that dimension, so assert UBOUND(A,DIM=1)==0, while DIM=2 has nonzero extent and asserts its upper bound 9. Pair with nonzero whole B(-2:3) asserting UBOUND(B,DIM=1)==3.

requirements.title: UBOUND DIM-absent vector result value
requirements.definition: For rank zero ARRAY, UBOUND(ARRAY) is zero-sized; otherwise element i of UBOUND(ARRAY) equals UBOUND(ARRAY,i), and the KIND form has corresponding selected-kind elements.

pending.UBOUND-rank-zero-result-zero-sized-array: Pass scalar integer x=17 to an assumed-rank dummy and assert SIZE(UBOUND(dummy))==0, paired with rank-one B(2:4) asserting UBOUND(B)==[4].
pending.UBOUND-vector-elements-match-DIM-inquiri: Use rank-three A(-3:4,7:9,0:2); assert UBOUND(A)==[4,9,2], matching UBOUND(A,1), UBOUND(A,2), and UBOUND(A,3), with non-unit lower bounds included. Use whole zero-extent Z(5:4,7:9) and assert UBOUND(Z)==[0,9], derived from scalar DIM inquiries; pair with nonzero whole B(-2:3) asserting UBOUND(B)==[3].
pending.UBOUND-vector-KIND-elements-match-select: Use the same rank-three A with KIND=selected_int_kind(18); assert KIND of vector elements equals the selected kind and values [4,9,2] match scalar KIND inquiries.
